title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30357: add prepayment credit memo confirmation event
summary: A handled event is added to the prepayment credit memo posting process, allowing extensions to replace the standard confirmation dialog just as they can for prepayment invoices.
key_points: Added a handled event before the credit memo confirmation in PostPrepmtCrMemoYN
Extensions can now provide custom confirmation experiences for prepayment credit memos
Matches existing customization capabilities already available for prepayment invoices
Subscribers can prevent the default dialog from showing
quote: Extensions need to replace the standard confirmation when posting sales prepayment credit memos
